scope: Architecture-independent F1 measurement contract at registered task/ecology/resource envelopes. This is a G1 registration artifact, not evidence that a system possesses a capability and not a G6 morphology-to-capability predictor.
assumptions: schema proofs are not empirical capability proofs
resource comparison is vector-valued unless nonnegative prices are preregistered
negative-twin minimality is local to one declared dependency
the concentration gate applies only to bounded independent evaluation units
evidence_class: P1 formal specification plus executable structural validation

definitions.A0: task specification plus legal observations/messages/actions through decision time plus own legal state; no protected labels, future/judge state, twin identity, or uncharged side channels
definitions.S0: for paired utility u in [0,1], d_plus=u(M,w_plus)-u(P,w_plus), d_twin=u(M,w_twin)-u(P,w_twin); with epsilon(n,alpha)=sqrt(2 ln(3/alpha)/n), require mean(d_plus)-epsilon(n_plus,alpha)>tau_parent and abs(mean(d_twin))+epsilon(n_twin,alpha)<=tau_twin
definitions.N0: remove exactly one registered capability-requiring conditional dependency while matching reward/action/scoring/remint family and non-target resource budgets
definitions.P0: the best preregistered member of the strongest behavioral parent envelope under the same allowed-information and resource restrictions receives first refusal

statistics.reason: one positive-world lower-tail event plus two twin-world tails; Bonferroni alpha/3 and Hoeffding for differences in [-1,1]
statistics.dependence_boundary: Repeated/adaptive dependent rows are outside this gate and must use a separately registered simultaneous-validity method.

resource_order.definition: r <= s iff every registered nonnegative resource coordinate of r is <= the corresponding coordinate of s
resource_order.scalarization_rule: A scalar price p^T r is admissible only when p is nonnegative and frozen before protected scoring; the underlying vector remains reportable.

strongest_parent_rule: In a finite enumerated parent class use the exact maximum. In an open class claim separation only from the preregistered searched envelope and report search coverage; the best tried baseline is not silently a universal optimum.
falsifier: Any coordinate missing required metadata, claim-ceiling escalation, protected information leakage, unmatched resources, parent non-separation, failed negative-twin collapse, or violation of the stated concentration assumptions invalidates the corresponding registered claim.
